description: This service publishes Romania's hospital activity indicators built from the national diagnosis-related group (DRG) data that hospitals report. It is run by the National Institute for Health Services Management (INMSS), which manages the DRG system and prepares quarterly indicators for the National Health Insurance House (CNAS). Users choose an indicator group, among volume and intensity of activity, surgical activity, comorbidity, socio-demographic profile of patients, circumstances of hospitalisation and variety of activity, and a level of aggregation: national, county, hospital category, specialty or hospital ward. A separate section gives morbidity indicators. Results are free and available on the web, with download as PDF or Excel for the morbidity indicators. Caveats: indicators are aggregated and designed for payment evaluation, not for capacity, the time span offered was not stated on the page read, and results are produced on request in the page, not as bulk files. Simulation uses: setting hospital case mix, length of stay and surgical volume by county for healthcare capacity models, and comparing regions before and after disruptions. Related records: the Polish NFZ statistics (data-nfz-poland-health-service-statistics) and the French hospital annual statistics (data-drees-sae-hospital-annual-statistics) are comparable sources.
